lede: Early US midterm results pointing to Democratic gains knocked the dollar and US stock futures overnight, lifting the euro, yen and franc. Gold is steady near $3,935 and Brent sits around $103 ahead of eurozone inflation and US services data.

focus.text: Flat near $3,935: a softer dollar offsets ~78% odds of a December Fed hike. Still capped below $3,975; US ISM services (18:00 TRT) and midterm counts are today's risks.
Up about 0.5% at 1.1249 on midterm-driven dollar selling and hawkish ECB talk, well above its 1.1191 pivot. Eurozone flash CPI at 13:00 TRT is the key test.

technicals.note: Former October support at $3,975 now acts as resistance, and the sequence of lower highs since the $4,000 break is intact.

technicals.note: Range-bound under a cluster of moving averages between 2,315 and 2,415, with 2,222 the nearest floor.

calendar.event: Riksbank rate decision — prev 1.75%, hike ~70% priced

news.text: Democrats took most early House calls and Jon Ossoff held Georgia's Senate seat; House control looks likely to flip while the Senate stays open.
The dollar index slipped toward 101.3 as investors sold dollars and bought Treasuries; the franc and yen gained most, sterling rose ahead of Thursday's BoE.
S&P 500 futures fell about 1% and Nasdaq futures 2% overnight after the cash S&P closed up 0.4%; AMD gained after hours on upbeat guidance.
Brent hovers near $103, around a four-week low, as Trump said there is no immediate plan to strike Iran and Tehran denied a deal is close.
Futures still price a high chance of a December Fed hike, and ECB's Nagel said a December rate rise is very likely needed.
US spot bitcoin ETFs shed about $399M on Monday, led by $405M leaving IBIT; ether ETFs lost roughly $140M.
Investigators link the $6.3B Binance breach to a compromised software supply chain and fake job offers; about $2.85B has been frozen or intercepted.
Zcash's NU7 upgrade activates Thursday, cutting target block time from 75 to 25 seconds.
RUNE jumped about 14%, HOT rallied as the HoloFuel network went live, and FLUID rose on early DEX V2 testing.
The CFTC chair said US equity perpetuals could list on regulated venues; South Korea plans to lift exchanges' cold-wallet requirement to about 99%.

upcoming.note: September 3.8% y/y; ECB hike talk building.
A hike is almost fully priced; first since 2023.
Key input for December Fed hike odds.
